rows.text_en: Ministry of Finance and Economy ( Financial and Taxation Division ), 044-215-4234

rows.source_ko: 제1조(외국의 유가증권시장) 「증권거래세법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제1조제3호에서 “재정경제부령이 정하는 시장”이란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 시장을 말한다. <개정 2009. 5. 11., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Foreign Securities Markets) In Article 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Securities Transaction Tax Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), the term “market prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to any of the markets falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended May 11, 2009; Jan 2, 2026>
1. Tokyo Stock Exchange
2. London Stock Exchange
3. Deutsche Stock Exchange

rows.source_ko: 4. 제1호부터 제3호까지와 기능이 유사한 거래소로서 「자본시장과 금융투자업에 관한 법률」 제406조제1항제2호의 외국 거래소
rows.text_en: 4. An exchange with functions similar to those in Subparagraphs 1 through 3, as referred to in Article 406, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Capital Markets and Financial Investment Business Act

[This Article was newly inserted on Oct. 1, 2004.]
[Former Article 1 was moved to Article 1-2 <Oct. 1, 2004>]

rows.source_ko: 제1조의2(본점일괄납부) ① 영 제1조의3제2항에 따른 본점일괄납부 신고서는 별지 제1호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-2 (Bulk Payment by Head Office) ①The report for bulk payment by the head office pursuant to Article 1-3, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제1조의3제3항에 따른 본점일괄납부 변경신고서는 별지 제1호의2서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The report on changes to lump-sum payment by the head office pursuant to Article 1-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 1-2 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제1조의3제6항에 따른 본점일괄납부 포기신고서는 별지 제1호의3서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ③ The declaration of waiver of lump-sum payment by the head office pursuant to Article 1-3, Paragraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 1-3 of the Attached Form .

[This Article was newly added on Feb. 23, 2013.]
[Formerly Article 1-2 was moved to Article 1-3 <February 23, 2013>]

rows.source_ko: 제1조의3(거래징수) 영 제6조에 따른 비과세양도명세서는 별지 제1호의4서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-3 (Collection of Transactions) The non-taxable transfer statement pursuant to Article 6 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 1-4 of the Attached Form .

[Wholly Amended Feb. 23, 2013]
[Moved from Article 1-2 <February 23, 2013>]

rows.source_ko: 제1조의4(증권계좌간 이체내역 등 제출) 영 제6조의3에 따른 주권등의 거래명세서는 별지 제1호의5서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-4 (Submission of transfer details between securities accounts, etc.) The transaction statement for stocks, etc. pursuant to Article 6-3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 1-5 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted Feb. 23, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제2조(증권거래세 과세표준 신고) 영 제7조제1항에 따른 증권거래세 과세표준신고서는 별지 제2호서식에 따른다. 이 경우 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 자료를 첨부하여야 한다. <개정 2021. 3. 16., 2025. 3. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Declaration of Tax Base for Securities Transaction Tax) The declaration of the tax base for securities transaction tax pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 2 of the Attached Form. In this case, the data classified according to each of the following subparagraphs must be attached. <Amended Mar. 16, 2021; Mar. 21, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제3조제1호에 따른 납세의무자의 경우: 별지 제2호서식 부표 1의 증권거래세 거래징수 내역서
rows.text_en: 1. In the case of a taxpayer liable under Article 3 , Subparagraph 1 of the Act : Securities Transaction Tax Transaction Collection Statement in Attached Table 1 of Form No. 2

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제3조제1호에 따른 납세의무자인 경우로서 법 제6조제1호에 따라 증권거래세를 부과하지 않는 경우: 별지 제1호의4서식의 비과세양도명세서
rows.text_en: 2. Cases where the taxpayer is liable under Article 3, Subparagraph 1 of the Act , but securities transaction tax is not imposed pursuant to Article 6, Subparagraph 1 of the Act : Statement of Non-taxable Transfer in Attached Form No. 1-4

rows.source_ko: 3. 법 제3조제1호에 따른 납세의무자인 경우로서 법 제10조제3항에 따라 증권거래세액에서 조정하여 환급할 세액이 있는 경우: 별지 제2호서식 부표 2의 조정환급명세서
rows.text_en: 3. In the case of a taxpayer liable under Article 3 , Subparagraph 1 of the Act , where there is a tax amount to be refunded by adjusting the securities transaction tax amount pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 3 of the Act : Adjustment Refund Statement in Attached Table 2 of Form No. 2

rows.source_ko: 4. 법 제3조제2호에 따른 납세의무자인 경우로서 법 제10조의2에 따른 사업자 단위 과세 사업자와 영 제1조의3에 따른 본점 또는 주사무소 일괄납부 사업자의 경우: 별지 제2호서식 부표 3의 사업장별 증권거래세 과세표준 및 산출세액 신고명세서(지점별 증권거래세 납부명세서)
rows.text_en: 4. In the case of a taxpayer liable under Article 3 , Subparagraph 2 of the Act , and a business operator subject to business unit taxation under Article 10-2 of the Act or a business operator subject to lump-sum payment at the head office or principal office under Article 1-3 of the Enforcement Decree: Statement of Declaration of Securities Transaction Tax Assessment Base and Calculated Tax Amount by Business Location (Statement of Securities Transaction Tax Payment by Branch) in Attached Table 3 of Form No. 2

rows.source_ko: 5. 법 제3조제3호에 따른 납세의무자의 경우: 별지 제2호서식 부표 4의 주권 또는 지분의 양도거래명세서 및 주권 또는 지분의 매매계약서 사본
rows.text_en: 5. In the case of a taxpayer liable under Article 3, Subparagraph 3 of the Act : A copy of the Statement of Transfer Transaction of Shares or Interests and the Sales Agreement for Shares or Interests as per Attached Table 4 of Form No. 2

rows.source_ko: 6. 「조세특례제한법」 제117조제1항에 따라 증권거래세를 면제하는 경우: 「조세특례제한법 시행규칙」 별지 제70호서식의 증권거래세 세액면제신청서
rows.text_en: 6. Cases where securities transaction tax is exempted pursuant to Article 117, Paragraph 1 of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act : Application for Exemption from Securities Transaction Tax (Form No. 70 of the Enforcement Rules of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act)
[Wholly Amended Mar. 14, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(장부의 비치기장) ①영 제9조에 규정하는 주권등의 거래장부는 별지 제3호서식에 의한다. 다만, 증권거래세법 제3조제1호의 납세의무자는 거래권별, 양도금액, 증권거래세, 과세 및 비과세 구분을 기재한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Keeping of Books) ① The transaction books for securities, etc., prescribed in Article 9 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 3 of the Attached Form. However, taxpayers liable under Article 3, Subparagraph 1 of the Securities Transaction Tax Act shall record the transaction details, the amount transferred, the securities transaction tax, and the classification of taxable and non-taxable transactions.

rows.source_ko: ②제1항에 규정하는 서식에 의하지 아니한 경우에도 영 제9조에 규정하는 기재사항의 전부가 기재된 경우에는 법 제15조의 규정에 의한 기장으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② Even if not in accordance with the form prescribed in Paragraph 1, if all the details prescribed in Article 9 of the Enforcement Decree are recorded, it shall be deemed as an accounting record pursuant to the provisions of Article 15 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: 제4조(조사증) 영 제11조에 규정하는 증표는 별지 제4호서식에 의한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Inspection Certificate) The inspection certificate prescribed in Article 11 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 4 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: ②(비과세양도명세서의 사용에 관한 경과조치) 별지 제1호서식의 개정서식은 증권거래법에 의한 증권예탁원이 성립한 날이후 최초로 신고하는 분부터 적용하며, 그 이전까지는 종전의 서식을 계속 사용한다.
rows.text_en: ② (Transitional Measures Concerning the Use of the Statement of Non-taxable Transfers) The amended Form No. 1 shall apply to the first report filed after the date on which the Korea Securities Depository is established pursuant to the Securities Exchange Act; prior to that date, the previous form shall continue to be used.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Finance Decree No. 1989, July 1, 1994>
① (Enforcement Date) This rule shall take effect on July 1, 1994.

rows.source_ko: ②(적용례) 이 규칙은 이 규칙 시행후 최초로 주권을 양도하는 분부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: ② (Application) This rule applies to those who transfer their shares for the first time after the enforcement of this rule.

ADDENDA <Ministry of Finance and Economy Decree No. 394, Oct. 1, 2004>
① (Enforcement Date) This rule shall take effect on October 1, 2004.

rows.source_ko: ②(적용례) 이 규칙은 이 규칙 시행후 주권 등을 양도하는 분부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: ② (Applicability) This rule shall apply to those who transfer shares, etc., after the enforcement of this rule.

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(서식에 관한 적용례) 서식에 관한 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 후 최초로 신고ㆍ납부하는 분부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to Forms)  The amended provisions regarding forms shall apply to the first report or payment made after the enforcement of this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(서식에 관한 적용례) 서식에 관한 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 후 신고 또는 제출하는 분부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to Forms)  The amended provisions regarding forms shall apply to reports or submissions made after the enforcement of this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(서식에 관한 적용례) 서식에 관한 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 후 신고 또는 제출하는 분부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to Forms)  The amended provisions regarding forms shall apply to reports or submissions made after the enforcement of this Rule.

This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(서식에 관한 적용례) 별지 제2호서식의 개정규정은 2019년 6월 3일 이후 주권을 양도한 분에 대해 신고하는 경우부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to Forms)  The amended provisions of Form No. 2 shall apply starting from the case of reporting for the transfer of share certificates on or after June 3, 2019.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(서식 개정에 관한 경과조치) 별지 제2호서식의 개정에 따라 신고를 할 수 없는 경우에는 종전의 서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Amendment of Forms)  In cases where a report cannot be filed pursuant to the amendment of Form No. 2 attached hereto, the previous form shall be used.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Economy and Finance Decree No. 778, Mar. 13, 2020>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on April 1, 2020.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(서식에 관한 적용례) 별지 제2호서식의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 이후 주권 등을 양도하는 분에 대해 신고하는 경우부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to Forms)  The amended provisions of Form No. 2 shall apply starting from cases where a report is filed regarding the transfer of share certificates, etc., after the enforcement of this Rule.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Economy and Finance Decree No. 845, Mar. 16, 2021>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Economy and Finance Decree No. 897, Mar. 18, 2022>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on July 1, 2022.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(서식에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 전에 증권시장에서 주권등의 매매거래가 체결된 경우에는 별지 제1호의4서식의 개정규정에도 불구하고 종전의 서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Forms)  In cases where a transaction for the sale of shares, etc., was concluded in the securities market prior to the enforcement of this Rule, the former form shall apply notwithstanding the amended provisions of Form No. 1-4 of the Appendix.

rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(증권거래세 과세표준 신고에 대한 적용례) 제2조제1호 및 별지 제2호서식 부표 1의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 이후 신고 또는 제출하는 경우부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to Declaration of Tax Base for Securities Transaction Tax)  The amended provisions of Article 2, subparagraph 1 and Annex 1 of Form No. 2 shall apply from the time of declaration or submission after the enforcement of this rule.
